notes: Search-indexed source item-side Wowhead Looter cumulative table displays 16 disenchant operations of this base item and 9 occurrences of Vibrant Shard, rounded 56%. This is NOT a new direct, item-version-separated original character experiment; the dynamically rendered table was not independently accessible in retrieved static HTML. Pooled uploads could vary in date, skill, build, item bonus and player. Neither output item units, original client patch, 0..N stack histogram, nor whole-operation zero events can be reconstructed. Vibrant Shard visual 1–2 stacks are not an observed histogram. Cross-output hit occurrences may overlap; never sum them to distinct operations. Same item ID under other locales or PTR is a potential mirror, not a new cohort.

source.title: Dragon Isles Prospecting and original numbered ore/herb outcome studies

notes: Distinct current pass before gear fallback. No new independently verified Serevite/Draconium/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic ore or Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling 0-inclusive event ledger; known cohorts not duplicated. Item-side gear values are lower-quality cumulative Looter data, not current-patch rank/skill-specific probability estimates.
lookingFor: New original completed-cast 0..N material-output studies for Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite and Prismatic prospecting, then Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy name-first Draconium Ore prospecting spreadsheet/Resourcefulness logs: existing original 10i63zb and related cohorts recognized, no previously unrecorded per-cast event ledger (https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/10i63zb)

Reddit r/woweconomy Serevite Ore prospecting logs/refunds and Prismatic Ore event histograms: known original sources and output averages only, no new output 0..N series (https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/108782r)
Wowhead Prismatic Ore prospecting original named result tables: previously indexed author families; sampled outcomes not original 0..N operations (https://www.wowhead.com/item=194545/prismatic-ore)

Wowhead original Blazing Pigment/Saxifrage comment by Aary: already indexed 100-herb R2/R3 sources; no new independent actual completed mill count or histogram (https://www.wowhead.com/item=198418/blazing-pigment)
Wowhead Serene Pigment/Bubble Poppy comment and rank pages: herb-to-pigment mapping only, not measured completed-cast yields (https://www.wowhead.com/item=198412/serene-pigment)

Blizzard US forums Draconium Ore prospecting named searches: no new original player completed-cast hit/zero export; profession discussions are not cohort results (https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/)
Warcraft Wiki Dragon Isles ore prospecting and Saxifrage milling name-first source search: recipe/reference facts, no independent ranked original casts (https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Prospect)

WoW-Professions named Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting and Inscription mill/prospect guide crosscheck: skill/refinement references without original completed operation log (https://www.wow-professions.com/guides/dragon-isles-inscription-leveling-guide-dragonflight)

Public GitHub original Draconium Ore prospecting result CSV/SavedVariables and Serevite rank raw log search: no inspectable novel 0..N event export (https://github.com/search?q=Draconium+Ore+prospecting&type=code)

Xenastro original Serevite/Draconium Prospecting Log spreadsheet URL rechecked but full sheet unavailable via current web view; prior imported row-level cohorts not counted again (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1jW-vz25Mha9GzeCe6qX9viuLyFsgDf2m/edit)

2022-10-30 Wowhead recap of Liqourice5's beta milling/Resourcefulness: historic 400 actions and 60 herb leftover belongs to known beta author study, not new retail pigment histogram (https://www.wowhead.com/news/crafting-work-orders-are-here-wowhead-economy-weekly-wrap-up-251-329620)
